193: +ACCENT = (64, 156, 255)  # #409cff

195: +BADGE_BG = (30, 41, 59)  # #1e293b
196: +HAIRLINE = (51, 65, 85)  # #334155
197: +
198: +MARGIN = 64
199: +PILL_LABEL = "Experimental"
200: +WORDMARK = "Agentic ODI"
201: +HEADLINE_SIZES = (84, 76, 68, 60, 52)  # shrink until the headline fits two lines

203: +# Mark geometry, normalized inside its bounding box: an ascending two-step
204: +# polyline (flat, riser, flat, riser, flat) ending in a filled apex dot.
205: +_MARK_POINTS = (

207: +    (0.42, 0.78),
208: +    (0.42, 0.53),
209: +    (0.66, 0.53),
210: +    (0.66, 0.28),
211: +    (0.84, 0.28),
212: +)
213: +
214: +
215: +def _wrap(
216: +    draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw,
217: +    text: str,
218: +    font: ImageFont.ImageFont,
219: +    max_width: float,
220: +) -> list[str]:
221: +    """Greedy word wrap measured with draw.textlength."""
222: +    lines: list[str] = []
223: +    current = ""
224: +    for word in text.split():
225: +        candidate = word if not current else f"{current} {word}"
226: +        if draw.textlength(candidate, font=font) <= max_width:
227: +            current = candidate
228: +        elif current:
229: +            lines.append(current)
230: +            current = word
231: +        else:
232: +            current = word
233: +    if current:
234: +        lines.append(current)
235: +    return lines

238: +def _draw_mark(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], line_width: int) -> None:
239: +    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
240: +    width = x1 - x0 + 1
241: +    height = y1 - y0 + 1
242: +    draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=max(2, width // 4), fill=SURFACE, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)
243: +    points = [(x0 + px * (width - 1), y0 + py * (height - 1)) for px, py in _MARK_POINTS]
244: +    draw.line(points, fill=ACCENT, width=line_width, joint="curve")
245: +    apex_x, apex_y = points[-1]
246: +    radius = max(2, round(width * 0.09))
247: +    draw.ellipse(
248: +        (apex_x - radius, apex_y - radius, apex_x + radius, apex_y + radius),
249: +        fill=ACCENT,
250: +    )
251: +
252: +

254: +    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=22)
255: +    pad_x = 20
256: +    height = 44
257: +    width = round(draw.textlength(label, font=font)) + 2 * pad_x
258: +    x1, y0 = right, cy - height // 2
259: +    x0, y1 = x1 - width, y0 + height
260: +    draw.rounded_rectangle((x0, y0, x1, y1), radius=height // 2, fill=BADGE_BG)
261: +    draw.text(((x0 + x1) / 2, cy), label, font=font, fill=BADGE_FG, anchor="mm")
262: +

264: +def _to_png(image: Image.Image) -> bytes:
265: +    buffer = io.BytesIO()
266: +    image.save(buffer, format="PNG", compress_level=9, optimize=True)
267: +    return buffer.getvalue()

272: +    subhead: str = DEFAULT_SUBHEAD,
273: +    url: str = DEFAULT_URL,

276: +    width, height = OG_SIZE
277: +    image = Image.new("RGB", OG_SIZE, CANVAS)
278: +    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
279: +
280: +    draw.rounded_rectangle((24, 24, width - 25, height - 25), radius=28, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)
281: +
282: +    mark_size = 44
283: +    _draw_mark(draw, (MARGIN, MARGIN, MARGIN + mark_size - 1, MARGIN + mark_size - 1), 3)
284: +    middle_y = MARGIN + mark_size // 2
285: +    draw.text(
286: +        (MARGIN + mark_size + 16, middle_y),
287: +        WORDMARK,
288: +        font=ImageFont.load_default(size=30),
289: +        fill=TEXT,
290: +        anchor="lm",
291: +    )
292: +    _draw_pill(draw, PILL_LABEL, right=width - MARGIN, cy=middle_y)
293: +
294: +    text_width = width - 2 * MARGIN
295: +    size = HEADLINE_SIZES[0]
296: +    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
297: +    headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
298: +    for size in HEADLINE_SIZES[1:]:
299: +        if len(headline_lines) <= 2:
300: +            break
301: +        font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
302: +        headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
303: +
304: +    y = 200
305: +    for line in headline_lines[:2]:
306: +        draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=font, fill=TEXT)
307: +        y += round(size * 1.25)
308: +
309: +    subhead_font = ImageFont.load_default(size=28)
310: +    y += 26
311: +    for line in _wrap(draw, subhead, subhead_font, text_width):
312: +        draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=subhead_font, fill=MUTED)

315: +    draw.text(
316: +        (MARGIN, height - MARGIN),
317: +        url,
318: +        font=ImageFont.load_default(size=26),

335: +    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
336: +    og_path = out_dir / "og.png"
